workflow: An attacker constructs an object containing malformed, truncated location metadata with a continuation marker indicating additional encoded fields.
A lazy metadata iterator decodes the variable-length fields without checking that each read remains within the metadata buffer.
The iterator consumes the buffer’s terminator and then reads adjacent heap bytes as if they were part of the encoded record.
The decoded values expose portions of unrelated heap data instead of producing a recoverable malformed-metadata error.
summary: Unchecked decoding of truncated metadata leaks adjacent heap data
decision_reason: No existing cluster has the same underlying workflow: this is an unchecked variable-length metadata read past a buffer boundary that discloses adjacent memory, rather than a matching ownership, arithmetic, synchronization, or generic boundary-optimization failure.
